title: Novel compound heterozygous mutation in <scp>SACS</scp> gene leads to a milder autosomal recessive spastic ataxia of Charlevoix‐Saguenay, <scp>ARSACS</scp>, in a Finnish family
abstract: Key Clinical MessageAutosomal recessive spastic ataxia of Charlevoix‐Saguenay is a rare disorder outside Quebec causing childhood‐onset cerebellar ataxia, peripheral neuropathy, and pyramidal tract signs. A Finnish family with milder form of ARSACS was found to harbor three mutations, p.E1100K, p.N1489S, and p.M1359T, in SACS gene. The mutations segregated with the disease.
